description: This file defines the LoadSheddingValidator class which validates LoadSheddingOptions configuration in Orleans. It checks thresholds for CPU and memory load and throws exceptions if they are out of valid ranges.

classes.name: LoadSheddingValidator
classes.description: A class that validates LoadSheddingOptions configuration, ensuring CPU and memory thresholds are within valid ranges.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the load shedding configuration by checking CPU and memory thresholds and throws exceptions if invalid.
